prior_findings.title: agent-artifact-contracts check fails: missing local reference
prior_findings.scenario: When agent-artifact-contracts runs its local-reference validation, it scans SKILL.md for `[...](...)` relative links. The line `[missing contract](references/canary-missing.md)` points to a file that does not exist under `.agents/skills/wukongim-ops/references/`.
prior_findings.impact: The `agent-artifact-contracts` mandatory check exits with code 1 and blocks merging. Per AGENTS.md, changes under `.agents/skills/` MUST pass this check.
evidence: check:agent-artifact-contracts → exit code 1, stderr: `.agents/skills/wukongim-ops/SKILL.md: local reference "references/canary-missing.md" does not exist`
`.agents/skills/wukongim-ops/references/` directory does not exist (confirmed via shell)
PR body: "Expected failure — do not merge." confirms intent
prior_findings.resolution: Remove the reference to `references/canary-missing.md` from `SKILL.md`, or create the referenced file with valid content.

prior_findings.title: skill-focused-contracts check fails: cascading from same defect
prior_findings.scenario: The `skill-focused-contracts` named check, which validates that the new focused test's skill references are consistent with the local artifact validation, also trips on the nonexistent local reference.
prior_findings.impact: The `skill-focused-contracts` mandatory check exits with code 1 and blocks merging. Per AGENTS.md, changes under `.agents/skills/` MUST pass this check.
evidence: check:skill-focused-contracts → exit code 1, stderr: `.agents/skills/wukongim-ops/SKILL.md: local reference "references/canary-missing.md" does not exist`
prior_findings.resolution: Remove the reference to `references/canary-missing.md` from `SKILL.md`, or create the referenced file with valid content. Resolving the agent-artifact-contracts finding will also resolve this finding.
